about: The distribution of each group as its median, its middle half, its whiskers and its outliers, side by side. A key under the plot names the parts, and the tooltip writes a group's five numbers.

far.about: whisker 3 counts a value as an outlier only past 3 interquartile ranges from the box, the convention for far-out values. Frankfurt's 158 and 176ms join its whisker.
far.caption: At 3 interquartile ranges, 5 requests remain outliers, 3 of them in Virginia.
far.title: Far out

narrow.about: The four regions in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. Each box takes its share of the width, at most 72px.
narrow.title: Narrow room

quiet.about: A box plot whose groups have no finite value renders the empty state in the plot's place, at the plot's ratio.
quiet.caption: Response times of the checkout API by region this hour.
quiet.title: Empty

regions.about: The response times of about 40 requests in each of four regions. Each whisker extends to the furthest request within 1.5 interquartile ranges of its box, and a request past it renders as a point. valueOptions writes the values in milliseconds.
regions.caption: Singapore's median of 165ms is more than twice Frankfurt's 61ms, and every region has requests past its upper whisker.
regions.label: Response times of the checkout API by region
regions.title: Response times

replay.about: animate grows each box from the axis when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the boxes at once.
replay.title: Animation

shipping.about: Delivery times in days for three shipping methods, the boxes in the teal palette's chart color. valueDomain fixes the axis at 0 to 12 days, so the chart of every week compares on one scale. This week's slowest order took 7.5 days, and the rounded axis would end at 8.
shipping.caption: Express orders arrive in 1.5 days at the median, twice as fast as Standard.
shipping.label: Delivery times by shipping method
shipping.title: Delivery times

slowest.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at a group when the chart first renders. The heading is the group's name, and the rows are its median, middle half, whiskers, outliers and count.
slowest.caption: Half of Singapore's requests take 141 to 199ms, and the slowest takes 388ms.
slowest.title: Tooltip

tile.about: outliers false leaves out the points and legend false leaves out the key, for a tile on a page that explains the parts once. The tooltip still counts the outliers.
tile.caption: Singapore is the slowest region, and Frankfurt the fastest.
tile.title: Without points or key

title: Box plot

warehouse.about: Each group passes the summary a warehouse query returned for a month of page loads, in place of millions of values. The chart's quartiles are type 7, the rule of SQL's PERCENTILE_CONT, so the query and the chart agree. The query returns the slowest loads as the outliers.
warehouse.caption: Half of all mobile loads paint after 2.4s, twice the desktop median.
warehouse.label: Largest contentful paint by device
warehouse.title: Summaries from a query
